script.text: @Statue Of Chulmir#end:touch    This is the statue of Chulmir.It issaid that those that kiss his brow are given a reward.!x1;Kiss Chulmir's brow.!x2;Leave.#end:x1You are granted 20 gems!#give gems 20#zap touch#end:x2#end:touch The statue will grant you no more gems.#end
@Arsenal Sign#end:touch    Beware:Beyond this wall lies King Lucius's arsenal.Dynamite is stored withinand can explode on contact!No torchesbeyond this point!#end
@Bear Cave Warning Sign#end:touch     Beware:In these woods lies the bearcave!#end

ANCIENT MAPI have been scouting the bear caves andhave discovered a secret passage on thesoutheast wall.I hope to journey thru it to the other side of the water.If onlyI can make it past the bears!          ________________          ] █    ██▒▒▒▒▒▒[          ]█      █▒▒▒▒▒▒[           ]   █  █▒▒▒▒▒▒▒[           ]   █  ▒▒▒▒▒▒▒ [          ]▓▓▓▓▓░░░░░░░░░[          ]▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓[          ----------------

DUKE WORTHY'S EMERALDSThis is the private treasury of Duke Worthy.All those caught stealing theseemeralds will perish in the dungeons.  --Duke Worthy     1283

@Ghost of Duke Worthy#end:touch    The spectral form of greedy Duke Worthy lives on!It speaks to you:"Hold,thief!Thou shalt not my emeralds steal!Perish at my hands!"#Shoot seek#shoot seek#end

@Duchess Worthy's Ghost#end:Touch     The ghostly form of the once beautiful Duchess Worthy appears beforeyou!She speaks to you:"In the hall south of the training room,at the far western end,push south on the wall.You will be in Duke Worthy's treasure chamber.He wishes to gaurd hisgems eternally,and I cannot continue on tothe spirit world and leave him here,alone.I beg of thee to take all of his blastedemeralds so our souls can finally rest inpeace!"#zap touch#end:touch     "Please,I trust in thee to do what must be done!Allow my husband and I to rest in peace,I beg of thee!"#end
@Treasury Sign#end:touchThis way to Duke Worthy's treasury.#end
@Dining Hall Sign#end:touchThis way to dining hall.#end
@Training Room Sign#end:touchThis way to training room.#end
@Oven Sign#end:touch     Magically heated ovens.Beware:Contents explosive!#end

Beware the jail cell in the dungeon.The vengeful dead shall force their hatred upon any that they see and they cannot bedefeated!
@Fake Energizer#end:touch     A voice booms through the chamber:"Art thou such a coward as to take the test only because thou couldst be safe?Surely thou dost not deserve to live!"#endgame

@Talking wall#end:touch     There is a face etched into this walland as you approach,its features spring tolife!"I suppose you want to enter the storage room?Well,to do so,you must tell me how many FAKE red keys there are on the thirdfloor.Any guesses?!x1; 1!x2; 2!x3; 4!x4; 5!x5; 8!x6; 10!x7; 13#end:x1You are incorrect.#zap touch#end:x2You are incorrect.#zap touch#end:x3You are incorrect.#zap touch#end:x4You are incorrect.#zap touch#end:x5You are incorrect.#zap touch#end:x6That's right!You may enter!#die:x7You are incorrect.#zap touch#end:touch     "I'm afraid I can't allow you to guess again.If you didn't know before,I'mnot supposed to let you go count the keysand THEN guess again.Sorry."#end

@Agumat#end:touch     The three pyramidal generators haveprojected a field of light around Agumat.Try as you might,you cannot penetrate thewhite field.#end:shutdown#char 216#change solid invisible#zap touch#end:touch#set agumatYou know have the holy sword,Agumat!#give score 10000#die

@switch#end:touch     This is the rainbow generator switch.It appears that it controls the flow oflight from the rainbow walls.Currently,itis on.!x1;Shut rainbow generators off#end:x1You flip the switch.#char 243#zap touch#if switch1 then shutoff#set switch1#end:shutoff#send agumat:shutdown#zap touch#char 243#end

@King:loop#go rndns#go cw rndns#throwstar seek#send loop:agumat     You raise Agumat above you.The king's ghost cringes.You bring the blade down upon it and with a flash of blinding light,King Lucius is nomore.#send ender:endtime#die

@ender#end:endtime$CONGRATULATIONS!     You have finished The Castle of KingLucius module for the ZZT game!I hope youhave enjoyed playing my module,and wouldlike to inform you that the Scourge of Sorania SuperZZT module is expected to befinished and available,sometime early in1992.Be sure to look for it!Hail!$-Eli (Avatar) Tremblay-#endgame
